title: Rivian - Charging (Canada/North America page)
notes: States: all 2026+ Rivian vehicles have a built-in NACS charge port; 2022-2025 have CCS and need a NACS DC adapter for Tesla Superchargers; battery warmed/cooled by preconditioning; every R2 has NACS. Page is in km (Canadian locale) and says Superchargers across North America.
